name: dsh-metaphysics
description: 命理排盘（玄学 xuanxue）for DeepSeek Harness: nineteen systems and eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, …), with climate adjustment (tiaohou), the 120 Qiongtong Baojian entries, 391-char name library with per-character pinyin, Kangxi stroke counts, five-grid (五格/三才) analysis and mechanical phonetics checks, classical quotes (Ziping Zhenquan / Di Tian Sui / San Ming Tong Hui), hexagram body relations (六冲/六合/伏吟/反吟/化进神/化退神) plus yongshen placement (用神落位) with month/day strength (月建日辰旺衰) and whole-hexagram per-line strength (全卦逐爻旺衰) and response-time clues (应期线索：逢值/逢冲/逢合 + 月建五态快慢) for liuyao, plus an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire and exact dayun handover dates (交运日) with annual suiyun hints (岁运并临/伏吟反吟), palace conditions (击刑/入墓), month states (旺相休囚死) and stem–palace relations (天盘干与宫生克) for qimen, flying four-transformations with chained flights (四化飞星串连), three-way-four-corner composite flights (三方四正复合飞化), switchable leap-month policy (闰月按日切分/整月归次月/整月归本月) nine school switches (亮度/庚干四化/天马/天空/截空旬空/魁钺/天伤天使/长生/晚子时) for ziwei, caliber diffs for bazi/ziwei/qimen (same inputs, one switch, root-field changes), shadow-chart IDs (same normalized params → same ID; version bumps auto-diff chart fields), step-by-step deduction traces (liuyao najia→liuqin→shiying→fushen→strength; bazi strength score and pattern/yongshen; ziwei pattern conditions), and a bundled offline single-file page (命理排盘.html), a panel-to-chat handoff that asks the Harness about a finished chart, per-tab lazy engine chunks so the first-screen client bundle stays under 100KB gzip, and a public verification report (128 classical hexagram cases, 312 Zi Wei charts × 34 patterns, 12 dayun handover cases) generated from the same source that gates CI.
author: xuanfu-web
